changelog: Fix: the 005 replication migration used a bare ADD COLUMN, so every update after the first logged `ERROR 1060: Duplicate column name 'btrfs_mode'`. It now uses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and re-runs cleanly. All migrations are now idempotent.

Updates no longer continue past a failed database migration. Because re-running migrations is now a clean no-op, any migration error is a real failure, so the updater rolls back instead of leaving new code running against a half-migrated schema — previously every error was written off as 'may have already been applied'.
The updater checks database connectivity once before applying migrations and reports a clear error if it cannot connect, rather than failing on each migration in turn.
